# Function toStructuredEvents

  * toStructuredEvents(event: [Event](../interfaces/Event.html)): [StructuredEvent](../types/StructuredEvent.html)[]

Converts an internal Event to a list of structured events. This is an optional utility for callers who want to easily identify the type of event they are handling.

#### Parameters

    * event: [Event](../interfaces/Event.html)

The raw event to convert.

#### Returns [StructuredEvent](../types/StructuredEvent.html)[]

The structured events.
